description: Mitigated direct-distribution microcampaign for the remaining Grover-Rudolph larger-grid profiles. This campaign measures prepared distributions only; it does not run Grover amplification or QAE.
rationale: The amplified gr_affine_n4 k=1 circuit is not yet stable enough for deeper QAE schedules.
The mitigated direct-distribution estimator gave the best current gr_affine_n4 upper_half estimate.
The next hardware question is whether direct mitigated distribution measurement generalizes to the remaining Grover-Rudolph profiles.
The gr_beta_bump_n4 case was deferred in the first distribution campaign and is the most important stress test because of its localized probability mass.

selected_cases.label: sin2(pi x), 8 midpoint cells
selected_cases.purpose: Mitigated repeat of the symmetric n=3 profile to quantify whether Runtime mitigation improves or perturbs an already stable distribution.

selected_cases.label: sin2(pi x / 2), 8 midpoint cells
selected_cases.purpose: Mitigated repeat of the monotone n=3 profile to compare against the first raw distribution run.

selected_cases.label: beta-like localized bump, 16 midpoint cells
selected_cases.purpose: First hardware run for the deferred localized n=4 Grover-Rudolph distribution.

stopping_rules: Do not submit any additional amplified Grover-Rudolph circuits until this suite is retrieved and compared to the raw distribution campaign.
If gr_beta_bump_n4 TVD is substantially above 0.05, perform a layout/seed audit before any QAE attempt on localized profiles.
If n=3 mitigation worsens TVD relative to the raw runs, avoid applying DD/twirling automatically to all short circuits.
If all three cases show TVD below or near their Phase 0 noisy estimates, proceed to a direct-observable estimator campaign rather than a deeper MLAE schedule.
